title: EOIP Relationship Constraints & Validation Rules
description: SHACL-equivalent constraint rules for the enterprise ontology. Enforced at ingestion time and by the ontology drift detector.

cardinality_constraints.description: Every commit must have exactly one author.
A repository can contain any number of files.
A work item has at most one parent.
A team has at most one lead.
Every deployment targets exactly one environment.

uniqueness_constraints.description: Repository URLs must be globally unique.
Email addresses must be unique within an organization.
Work item keys must be unique within a project.
Commit SHAs must be unique within a repository.

existence_constraints.description: Every CodeFile must belong to a Repository.
Every Deployment must target an Environment.
Every TestCase must belong to a TestSuite.

temporal_constraints.description: Sprint end date must be after start date.

temporal_constraints.rule: resolved_at IS NULL OR resolved_at >= created_at
temporal_constraints.description: Incident resolution must be after creation.
Every deployment must have a deployment timestamp.

cross_domain_rules.description: A Commit that IMPLEMENTS a WorkItem must modify at least one CodeFile in the WorkItem's project repository.
An Incident with severity CRITICAL must have at least one RESOLVED_BY Commit within the SLA window.
A Service with tier P1 must have at least one associated Runbook.
